# Belegfluss

> Belegfluss is an invoice inbox for small businesses: incoming invoices are uploaded, read into
> structured data, checked automatically and taken through a four-eyes approval to booking.
> German e-invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD) are taken over exactly without AI; only plain PDFs and
> scans are read by a language model. A portfolio project by Omar Fourati with public source code,
> not a commercial product. The user interface is in German.

- Live demo (read-only demo account on the login page): https://belegfluss.omarfourati.de/app/
- Source code: https://github.com/omarfourati-dev/belegfluss
- API documentation (OpenAPI): https://belegfluss.omarfourati.de/swagger-ui.html
- Author: Omar Fourati, Full-Stack Developer - https://omarfourati.de

## How an invoice is read

The cheapest exact source comes first:

1. E-invoice: XRechnung (UBL 2.1 and UN/CEFACT CII), ZUGFeRD and Factur-X, uploaded as XML or embedded
   in a PDF. Parsed exactly, no AI, no cost. The XML parser is hardened against XXE.
2. PDF with a text layer: the text goes to a language model; Spring AI returns a typed Java record
   (supplier, invoice number, dates, net, VAT, gross, currency, IBAN).
3. Scanned PDF: the first pages are rendered as images and read by a vision model.

All fields can be corrected by hand; the audit trail lists which fields changed.

## Automatic checks

- Duplicate: same supplier and invoice number already exists
- Amounts: net plus VAT does not equal gross
- VAT rate: not one of the usual German rates (0, 7, 19 %)
- Invalid IBAN: mod-97 check digit fails
- IBAN changed: a known supplier suddenly gives a different IBAN (typical invoice fraud)

Approving an invoice with warnings requires a comment.

## Roles and approval

Roles: viewer, employee (upload, correct), approver, accounting (book, CSV export), admin (users).
Each role includes the rights of the roles below it. Four-eyes rule: neither the uploader nor the
person who last corrected the fields may approve. Every step is recorded in an audit trail.
Booked invoices are exported as CSV in a DATEV-like format.

## Technology

- Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Spring AI, Spring Security (JWT, role hierarchy), PostgreSQL,
  Flyway, PDFBox, virtual threads, Server-Sent Events, RFC 9457 problem details
- Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Quality: JUnit 5, Testcontainers, Vitest, Playwright end-to-end tests of the whole approval process
- Operations: Docker, GitHub Actions, Caddy; login throttling against brute force

## FAQ

- Does every invoice need AI? No. E-invoices are read exactly from the XML. Only PDFs without
  e-invoice data and scans use a model.
- Is it a product I can buy? No, it is a portfolio project that shows how such a system can be built.
